Linear search aur binary search mein main difference kya hai?

Linear search array ke har element ko ek-ek karke check karta hai, isliye iski time complexity O(n) hoti hai. Binary search sorted array ko har step par aadha divide karta hai, jisse lookup O(log n) mein complete hota hai. Binary search sirf sorted data par kaam karta hai.

When should I add a SQL index and what is the trade-off?

Add a B-Tree index on columns frequently used in WHERE, JOIN, or ORDER BY clauses with high selectivity. The trade-off is slower INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE operations and extra disk/RAM usage because each write must also update the index structure.

Compare Docker containers vs Virtual Machines concisely.

Virtual Machines run a full guest OS over a hypervisor, causing higher memory overhead and slower boot times. Containers share the host Linux kernel via namespaces and cgroups, making them lightweight, fast-starting, and consistent across dev and production.

Python mein generator aur list comprehension mein memory ka kya farak hai?

Explain the JavaScript Event Loop execution order clearly.

JavaScript executes synchronous frames on a single call stack. When the call stack empties, the Event Loop drains the entire microtask queue (Promises, `queueMicrotask`) before dequeuing the next single macrotask (`setTimeout`, I/O callbacks) and rendering frames.

If a train leaves Station A at 60 km/h and another leaves Station B 35 km away towards each other at 80 km/h, when do they meet?

Why is Node.js vm.runInNewContext unsafe for untrusted code execution?

The Node `vm` module is not a security boundary: untrusted code can walk constructor chains (`this.constructor.constructor('return process')()`) to reach host `process` and filesystem modules. Execute untrusted snippets in a separate OS process or container with stripped environment and strict resource limits.

Why should continual LoRA retraining include a golden replay mix from the base model?

Retraining a previous adapter sequentially on narrow new user data causes catastrophic forgetting of core coding and reasoning capabilities. Training a fresh adapter from the base model on ~70% curated new examples mixed with ~30% verified golden anchors preserves baseline quality.

Why is cross-entropy loss masked with -100 on prompt tokens during SFT?

In PyTorch `CrossEntropyLoss(ignore_index=-100)`, tokens labeled `-100` contribute zero loss and zero gradients. Masking system and user prompt tokens concentrates LoRA capacity purely on predicting assistant responses rather than memorizing user prompts.

How does Double-Submit CSRF protection work alongside CORS?

CORS alone does not block simple cross-origin form requests if cookies attach automatically. With Double-Submit CSRF, the server sets a readable random cookie (`bantai_csrf`) and requires mutations to echo the exact value in an `X-CSRF-Token` header verified via constant-time comparison plus an allowed `Origin` check.

Explain why cosine similarity is normalized by vector magnitudes in RAG retrieval.

Raw dot products grow proportionally with document length and term frequency, biasing retrieval toward long chunks. Dividing by the product of L2 norms (`||A|| * ||B||`) measures only the angle between vectors in [−1, 1], keeping retrieval length-invariant.

Why use serialized write queues alongside atomic renames when persisting local JSON stores?

Why does the sky look blue during clear daylight?

Atmospheric nitrogen and oxygen molecules are much smaller than visible wavelengths, producing Rayleigh scattering proportional to 1/λ^4. Shorter blue wavelengths scatter roughly 10 times more intensely than longer red wavelengths, filling the daytime sky with blue light.
